parsing context.name: pseudo header info
parsing context.description: the concept prefixing the udp header, containing source address, destination address, protocol (17), and udp length (derived from 'length' field).

helper functions.name: calculate checksum
helper functions.description: calculates the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of the pseudo header, the udp header, and the data, padded with zero octets at the end if necessary.
